overview_description.description:
RentHop simplifies real estate decisions through technology and quantitative analysis.

In large cities apartment search is painful because there are far too many choices and very few great finds. It created the HopScore, a proprietary algorithm to sift through available inventory and sort by quality; saving time for both renters, landlords, and real estate brokers.

about_short_description.short_description: RentHop is a web platform that provides users with an apartment-search web facility.

product.name: Apartment Search Platform
product.description: A web-based platform that allows users to search for apartments by location, price, amenities, and other filters.

product.name: HopScore AI Ranking System
product.description: An AI-based system that ranks apartment listings by quality and accuracy using rental data and transaction history.

product.name: RentHop Mobile App
product.description: A mobile application that enables users to search, save, and receive alerts for apartment listings with map visualization and personalized features.

product.name: Listing Management and Advertising Services
product.description: Services for landlords, agents, and management companies to post and manage rental listings on RentHop's platform.

product.name: Pro Referral Program
product.description: A referral program that rewards users with credits for referring new agents to RentHop's Pro Plans.
